column3: Kill 15 Boulderfist Shaman and 10 Boulderfist Lords and return to Drum Fel in the Hammerfall outpost.
column4: The head of the beast is ready to be taken off... with great force, $n. You have shown every sign that you are able to help us with this final mighty blow. The leaders of these attacks have made their lair within the ruins of Stromgarde, a glaring symbol of human frailty.$B$BFind and slay those Boulderfist lords and their lackey shaman who would try and drive us from these lands.

column3: Bring 5 Mistvale Giblets to "Shaky" Phillipe in Booty Bay.
column4: If there's one thing I can't stand, it's people who don't pay their gambling debts!  And there are a lot of people who owe me. Think you can help me collect?$B$BFirst, there's "Shaky" Phillipe down by the docks.  He owes me plenty after last week's game and I want my due!  But to get it, we'll have to scare him.$B$BGo out of town and hunt Elder Mistvale Gorillas.  Find a nice selection of giblets, then take them to Shaky.  Don't let on that they're from an animal; let him think the worst.

column3: Kill High Inquisitor Whitemane, Scarlet Commander Mograine, Herod, the Scarlet Champion and Houndmaster Loksey and then report back to Varimathras in the Undercity.
column4: Whilst the Dark Lady tends to the pressing issue of the Lich King's advance to the north, I am seeing to it that matters closer to home are being taken care of accordingly.$b$bNo doubt, the human pests who call themselves the Scarlet Crusade are proving to be the sharpest thorn in our side domestically. Tirisfal Glades is literally crawling with the little red ants.$b$bTravel to the Monastery, $c, and lay waste to High Inquisitor Whitemane and her top lieutenants.

column3: Speak with Tabetha in Dustwallow Marsh.
column4: Rumor is that Tabetha, a mage colleague who lives deep in Dustwallow Marsh, has a bone to pick with a certain sand troll in Zul'Farrak.  If you speak with Tabetha she can tell you more.$B$BAnd bring some friends with you, $n.  If Tabetha has you go to Zul'Farrak then you're not going to want to go alone.$B$BYou will find Tabetha's cottage west of Theramore, and just north of the Stonemaul Ruin.

column3: Kill Lord Aliden Perenolde and ask his mistress, Elysa, about Taretha's pendant.
column4: It is clear that Perenolde must be killed, his foulness removed from the world. His manor lies a ways to the north of here, on the shores of Lordamere Lake. Do your duty, $n, then retrieve the pendant that the Warchief desires, and return here.

column5: Follow the road to Go'shek farm, south and a bit west of here. You'll likely find it packed and ready to go, with Jorell either missing or unconcerned with his obligations.

column3: Some of the little ones have escaped across the river. They're still too small to be harvested out in the field so we need to return them here. Take this stick and give them a good swat! That should send them scampering back to their pens.
Bring 10 pieces of Turtle Meat and some Soothing Spices to Christoph Jeffcoat in Tarren Mill.
column4: Who says that the undead don't know anything about cooking? Take my secret recipe for Turtle Bisque, for example. I've known folks that would come back from the dead just to enjoy a bowl! Heh, heh...$B$BSpeaking of which, I haven't been able to make any lately.  I used to head over to Lake Lordamere myself to hunt snapjaws, the nasty things, but I can't pull myself away from my work here.$B$BIf you bring me some Turtle Meat from the snapjaws and soothing spices, I'll show you how it's done!

column3: I ran away, and I'm fine, but now they won't let me play outside of the camp anymore. Can you make it safe for me, and then tell my mum?
Far Seer Mok'thardin at the Grom'gol base camp wants 8 Shadowmaw Claws and a Pristine Tigress Fang.
column4: The power of the jungle's magic must be realized and then harnessed by the Horde.  My rituals have proven successful so far.  I can cast very powerful enchantments.  For you, brave $c, I shall make a special item indeed.$b$bBring to me some Shadowmaw Panther claws along with a Tigress fang.  Not just any fang will do.  It must be in pristine condition.$b$bThe beasts lurk throughout the jungle but you will find some close by, just across the river from Mizjah Ruins to the southeast.
